svg.title: The regular logarithms Lλ comprise the old regular activity and cubic, quartic, loop and quadratic-tail energy pieces, the remote row and local chart terms, and the finite ledger terms from Gaussian completion and covariance reweighting. Their signs are the signs in the exponent of the original density: in particular an old regular occurrence contributes its negative value. A warn- ing vertex is zero when mandatory; otherwise it is its fluctuation cutofftimes the corresponding sector-profile complement. The Gaussian warnings are also retained in this warning alphabet. All factors in (PRI2) use this single configuration, signal and Gaussian variable. Put bp(Y, z) = Q α∈p vα(Y, z). The primitive value before the finite choice average is the literal integral
